hyperliquid.name: get_me
hyperliquid.description: Show this Hyperliquid account: network (mainnet or testnet), address, and whether a trading key is saved. Makes no request.

hyperliquid.name: list_markets
hyperliquid.description: List perpetual and spot markets with their asset index, size decimals and maximum leverage (one page). Spot names look like PURR/USDC or @107.

hyperliquid.name: get_mids
hyperliquid.description: Read mid prices in USDC for the named coins, or the first 100 coins by name.

hyperliquid.name: get_book
hyperliquid.description: Read the level 2 order book of a coin: bids and asks, price in USDC and size in coin units.

hyperliquid.name: get_candles
hyperliquid.description: Read OHLCV candles of a coin, oldest first. Prices in USDC, volume in coin units. Defaults to the latest candles.

hyperliquid.name: get_funding_history
hyperliquid.description: Read a perp's hourly funding rate history, oldest first (rates are per hour, as fractions). Defaults to the last 7 days.

hyperliquid.name: get_account
hyperliquid.description: Read an account's perp positions and margin summary (USDC) and its spot balances.

hyperliquid.name: get_open_orders
hyperliquid.description: List an account's open orders with ids (one page).

hyperliquid.name: get_fills
hyperliquid.description: List an account's recent fills, newest first (one page).

hyperliquid.name: get_funding_payments
hyperliquid.description: List funding payments an account paid or received, oldest first. Defaults to the last 7 days.

hyperliquid.name: get_portfolio
hyperliquid.description: Read an account's account-value and PnL history in USDC for one timeframe (the latest 48 points).

hyperliquid.name: get_vaults
hyperliquid.description: List the vaults an account holds a deposit in, with equity in USDC.

hyperliquid.name: get_order_status
hyperliquid.description: Read one order's status by order id or client order id, to confirm what happened to it.

hyperliquid.name: place_order
hyperliquid.description: Place one limit order. The result states the network and exactly what was signed and sent, and Hyperliquid's own reply with the order id. Price and size are never rounded for you; a value that is not valid is refused. Never retried. Only on the user's explicit instruction.

hyperliquid.name: modify_order
hyperliquid.description: Replace an open order (by oid, or by the client order id in order_to_replace) with a new one. Everything in the new order is given in full. The result states the network and what was sent. Never retried. Only on the user's explicit instruction.

hyperliquid.name: cancel_order
hyperliquid.description: Cancel one open order by order id, or by client order id. The result states the network and Hyperliquid's reply. Never retried.

hyperliquid.name: set_leverage
hyperliquid.description: Set the leverage of a perp, cross or isolated. Spot has no leverage.

hyperliquid.name: schedule_cancel
hyperliquid.description: Arm a dead man's switch that cancels every open order after a delay, or clear it. Hyperliquid allows 10 triggers a day.
